pages.html:
✂️ Bella

Welcome to Bella Salon

Elevate your beauty with expert hair care and personalized styling

Book Your Appointment

Our Services

Haircut & Style

$45

Professional haircut tailored to your face shape and hair type, including a complimentary style consultation and blow-dry finish.

Book Now

Hair Coloring

$75–$150

Full color, highlights, balayage, or dimensional color techniques using premium brands. Includes strand test and personalized shade selection.

Book Now

Keratin Treatment

$120

Smoothing and frizz-control treatment that leaves hair silky and manageable for up to 3 months. Perfect for all hair types.

Book Now

Blow Dry

$35

Professional blow-dry styling for any occasion. Includes scalp massage and product recommendations tailored to your needs.

Book Now

Hair Extensions

$200–$400

Premium hand-tied or tape-in extensions for added length and volume. Custom color matching and personalized application.

Book Now

Bridal Package

$250

Complete bridal hair services including consultation, trial run, and wedding-day styling. Includes updos, curls, and accessories.

Book Now

What Our Clients Say

"Bella transformed my hair completely! The team is so knowledgeable and made me feel welcome from day one. I've never had better color."

— Sarah M.

"My wedding hair was absolutely perfect. The stylist listened to every detail and brought my vision to life. Highly recommend!"

— Jessica L.

"The keratin treatment changed my life. My frizzy hair is now smooth and shiny. Worth every penny and the team is amazing!"

— Emma T.
